clauses.heading: Mystery Bounty Rules
clauses.text:
The Tournament will reward participants for eliminating another player (the “Bounty”). Each player 
who eliminates a Bounty from the Tournament will receive a prize (as outlined below) from the 
Bounty prize pool.  
 
Each player who advances to Day 2 will be designated as a “Mystery” Bounty. 
 
All Tournament and Bounty prizes are included in the Tournament guaranteed prize pool of 
$500,000 (the “Guarantee”). In the event that the number of paid entries does not generate at 
least the Guaranteed prize pool, after the deduction of the Tournament fees and service charge, 
$325,000 of the Guarantee will be designated for the Tournament prize pool and $175,000 of the 
Guarantee will be designated for the Bounty prize pool. 
 
In the event that multiple players eliminate a Bounty with the same winning hand, all players with a 
Tournament chip count equal to or greater than the eliminated Bounty prior to the start of the hand 
will equally split the corresponding Bounty prize.  
  
On Day 2, a player eliminating a Bounty will receive a voucher for a “Mystery” Bounty prize. 
“Mystery” Bounty prizes may be redeemed by presenting the Mystery Bounty prize voucher to the 
Tournament staff located at the designated redemption location, at which time the player will 
randomly draw an envelope from the “Mystery Bounty” drawing drum to reveal their “Mystery” 
Bounty prize. 
 
Once received, Mystery Bounty prize vouchers are the sole responsibility of the player. Lost or 
stolen Mystery Bounty prize vouchers will not be replaced.  
 
“Mystery” Bounty prize amounts will be determined based on actual Tournament Entry Fees 
received and displayed in the Tournament area prior to the beginning of the Tournament restart 
on Day 2.

clauses.heading: Bounty Rules
clauses.text:
The Tournament will reward participants for eliminating another player (the “Bounty”). Each player who 
eliminates a Bounty from the Tournament will receive a prize (as outlined below) from the Bounty prize 
pool.  
 
All Tournament and Bounty prizes are included as part of the guaranteed prize pool of $100,000 (the 
“Guarantee”). In the event that the number of Tournament entries do not generate at least the Guarantee 
the Tournament prize pool will be equal to $100,000 less the total amount of entries multiplied by $500 for 
the Bounty prize pool [$100,000 – (total entries x $500)].  
 
Players are responsible for keeping their own Bounty chips visible and on the table at all times during their 
Tournament play. A player who misplaces or loses their assigned Bounty chips will be required to replace 
them at their own expense. Failure to follow this rule may result in a penalty, up to and including 
disqualification and forfeiture of Tournament and Bounty chips. 
 
When a player is eliminated from the Tournament, the winner(s) of that hand will be awarded one (1) 
Bounty chip of each eliminated player(s). 
 
Bounty chips are only to be used for purposes of the Bounty prize pool in this Tournament and will only be 
exchanged for a live poker chip as outlined below. Bounty chips have no cash value and cannot otherwise 
be exchanged or substituted. Each Bounty chip is assigned a value of $500. 
 
In the event multiple players eliminate a Bounty with the same winning hand, all players with a Tournament 
chip count equal to or greater than the Bounty prior to the start of the hand will receive an equally split 
portion of the Bounty chip(s) of the eliminated player(s). 
 
Removal of Bounty chips from the table or any attempt to manipulate or circumvent the Bounty chip 
exchange may result in penalty, up to and including disqualification.

The Tournament Prize will be one (1) direct entry seat into the $10,400 WPT World Championship Poker Tournament to be held on 
December 13-20, 2026. The total number of available Tournament Prizes will be based on the total number of Entry Fees received. 
One (1) Tournament Prize, valued at $10,400, will be generated for every 10.7 Entry Fees received (the “Tournament Prize 
Formula”).  
 
A Player who accumulates 220,000 in tournament chips (“The Milestone”) or more will instantly be awarded one (1) Tournament 
Prize. Upon verification from the tournament supervisor that the player has achieved the Milestone, the player will cease play and 
the total of his/her chips will be removed from play.  
 
The Tournament will conclude when the number of players remaining is equal to the number of $10,400 prizes generated based on 
the Tournament Prize Formula, less the amount of players who have previously won the prize by reaching the Milestone. Any 
Tournament prize pool residual funds, less than a full $10,400 prize, will be paid in Wynn Las Vegas casino chips to the last player 
eliminated prior to the conclusion of the Tournament.

The $600 Buy-In is allocated as follows: $510 to Prize Pool; $50 House Fee; $40 Voluntary Staff Gratuity.
Each Flight would play until the money (12.5%). Must bag chips to make Day 2 and be in the money.
Of the $600 Buy-in, $510 goes to the Prize Pool, $50 is Admin Fees and $40 is optional staff gratuity.
Bellagio guarantees that the total Combined Prize Pool will be at least $50,000.
The $400 Buy-In is allocated as follows: $340 to Prize Pool; $35 House Fee; $25 Voluntary Staff Gratuity.
Payout structure based on number of entries and will be approximately 12.5% of field.

Of the $160 buy in, $115 goes to the prize pool and $45 is held by Caesars Palace as a maintenance fee.
